_about: Clasp and chain audit of every existing Toggle Link Chain photo, the generated photo live on the product page, and the five Toggle ads live on Meta (4 Nov 2026). The photo audit was done by an independent checker against the three real listing photos at full zoom; the live ads were checked here. Pixel-level notes for each photo are kept in the session scratchpad (toggle15/audit/).

truth.clasp: A thick polished spring-gate ring with flat-cut collared ends at the top, a slimmer gate between them, and a small ball push-pin nub on a grooved collar at about 3 o'clock; the right chain joins it by a jump ring beside the gate. On the other chain end, a short pave piece with one row of tiny clear stones, hung from a small jump ring and passing through the ring.
truth.open_question: The worn and velvet listing photos show the pave piece as a straight single-row bar, and the description says 'toggle bar'. The cube listing photo shows it as an oval pave hoop threaded on the ring. The new ads draw the straight bar (two of three photos and the description); the owner is asked to check a physical piece.
truth.proportions: Judged against the real photos (bar about 0.6x the ring, links about 0.2x the ring wide), because 15 mm ring and 4 mm links cannot both be exact: the real ring reads about 17-20 mm against 4 mm links.
